verdict.rationale: Helicone has its own export path for logged data: a user reports Helicone lets them 'see each request and export them all' to build a fine-tuning dataset, and the GitHub README advertises a one-line export to PostHog. A REST request-query API and HQL also expose the logs programmatically. None of this documents a bulk export to blob storage (S3/GCS) or a data warehouse, so the story's destination requirement is unmet. missing for 10: native blob-storage/S3 export, data-warehouse connectors (e.g., Snowflake/BigQuery), documented bulk/scheduled export of traces and datasets, first-party export docs.
